CONCEPT PROJECT / DIGITAL EXPERIENCE · MOTION

Orbit↗

A playful digital space for collecting ideas and turning them into something real.

ROLE
Digital experience · Motion
TIMELINE
8-week concept
STATUS
Concept / 2026
TOOLS
Figma, After Effects, HTML/CSS
01 / THE CHALLENGE

How can a creative workspace help people start without overwhelming them with tools?

The approach

A lightweight canvas, clear entry points, and gentle motion create a space that invites exploration while keeping the next step visible.

The intended outcome

A responsive interface concept spanning discovery, collections, and a focused workspace. Usability and keyboard navigation would be evaluated with real users.

Illustrative concept. No real client, launch, or measured results are claimed.
EXPLORE THE DETAILS
01 / 03
02 / BEHIND THE IDEA

From a question
to a point of view.

01 — RESEARCH

Find the right question.

Outlined a simple journey from a saved thought to a first draft. Too many choices at the start became the main friction to address.

02 — SKETCH & EXPLORE

Follow a few loose threads.

Tested low-fidelity layouts and simple transition studies before refining navigation, components, and focus states.

03 — DESIGN & REFINE

Make the idea tangible.

A circular visual metaphor links the identity with the interaction system. Bright moments guide attention, while the canvas stays neutral.

04 / WHAT I’M TAKING FORWARD

Little details.
Lasting lessons.

Motion is most useful when it explains a relationship. Small transitions made the structure feel tangible without competing with the work.
